reading.title: Animals Around Us
reading.text: Our school has a small farm. The children look after the farm animals every day. In the morning we feed the animals and in the afternoon we clean their house. A bird has built a nest on the roof, and birds sing there every morning. There is also a pond with a few fish. Last Friday the teacher told us about an endangered animal called the snow leopard.

listening.title: Fishing Trip
listening.script: Last Sunday my uncle and I went fishing on a quiet lake. Birds were singing in the trees around us. After two hours my uncle caught a big fish. We saw a school of small fish under the boat, too. In autumn many birds fly south, and I saw a large flock above the lake. In the evening we had fish and chips at home.

reading.title: My Pet Dog
reading.text: I have a pet dog called Max. He is brown and very friendly. It is my job to look after him, so I feed him and walk him every day. Max barks when someone comes to the door, but he never bites. Last month he was ill, and Mum took him to the vet. Now he is well again and runs in the park.

listening.script: A stray cat lives near our school. Nobody keeps her as a pet, so the children bring her milk. She likes to chase mice behind the old library. When the girls stroke her, she purrs loudly. The teacher says we can take her to the pet shop for a collar next week.

reading.title: In the Greenhouse
reading.text: Our school has a small greenhouse. Every Monday we water the plants and look at how they grow. This week we planted a seed of a sunflower. Every plant needs light, so we put the pots near the window. In the village farmers grow crops like wheat and cotton. In autumn they harvest the crops, and this year it was a good crop.

listening.script: In spring the farmer plants seeds in his fields. In summer he waters the crops because the weather is hot and dry. Last year the crops failed because there was no rain. This year the weather was better, so the crop was good. In October he and his sons harvest the crops and sell them at the market.

reading.text: We have a big back garden. In the garden there is a tall tree, and I sometimes climb it. We also have two fruit trees: an apple tree and a cherry tree.
